facts.fact: The Ministry of Culture describes Sqala du Port as a defensive element protecting the harbour, related to the quay and dry dock.
facts.location: Visible source paragraph/table containing: dry dock
facts.excerpt: f two fortified wings, each 200 meters long, intersecting at a right angle. One wing, located behind the Gate of the Navy, overlooks the quay and the dry dock, while the other faces the archipelago and rises above stores that once housed soldiers, ammunition, and water supplies.
